subject: Request: brief extension while PO routes — preserving sandbox progress
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@starkmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lydia Torres <lydia.torres@starkmed.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Trial window — procurement routing causing access gap

Hi Marissa,

Quick note — our security and procurement teams are doing final checks but routing the PO will take longer than anticipated. We made good progress in the sandbox (NLP pipelines + model integration) but the trial is set to expire next Wednesday. Procurement expects a 7–10 business day routing back to us because of a vendor onboarding audit.

Can Redwood push the sandbox window or issue a short-term token/top-up so we don't lose the work we've done? If needed, I can get a brief note from procurement confirming the routing timeline.

Attachments: PO-draft-starkmed.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Brooks
CTO, StarkMed
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@starkmed.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T12:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement routing causing access gap

Evan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We definitely don't want you to lose momentum. We can provision a short-term safeguard while the PO routes: 72 hours of sandbox vouchers immediately, plus the option to extend up to 10 business days on an approved case note from your procurement team. To move forward I need either: (1) a one-line confirmation from procurement with expected routing time, or (2) a signed DocuSign for the standard SOW addendum (quickest for billing).

I'll cc Camila on the SOW and Priyom for billing so they can prepare the voucher and a minimal extension agreement. If you want a manager escalation for a longer runway now, I can loop Grace.

Proposed next steps:
- Evan: confirm procurement routing ETA or have procurement reply to this thread
- Camila/Priyom: prepare 72hr voucher + draft extension_terms.txt
- Marissa: approve voucher once docs are in place

Attachment: acknowledgement template (I can populate it if procurement prefers).

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0184
From: Lydia Torres <lydia.torres@starkmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T08:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement routing causing access gap

Hi Marissa / Camila,

Thanks — confirmed that the PO is in routing with our vendor onboarding team. Unfortunately, the audit step was added yesterday so procurement estimates 10 business days to fully approve. We can provide a short confirmation email for your records that the PO is active and routed.

Two asks from our side to accept an extension: please provide (A) the exact services/features preserved during the extension (no billing change), and (B) a contact for invoices once the PO completes routing. We cannot sign addenda via DocuSign from procurement; we prefer an internal statement that the trial extension is a goodwill accommodation while PO routes.

On Tue, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Evan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.
> 
> We definitely don't want you to lose momentum. We can provision a short-term safeguard while the PO routes: 72 hours of sandbox vouchers immediately, plus the option to extend up to 10 business days on an approved case note from your procurement team.

Best,
Lydia
Lydia Torres
Procurement, StarkMed
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Torres <lydia.torres@starkmed.com>, Evan Brooks <evan@starkmed.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement routing causing access gap

Lydia — appreciate the clarity. This is an official note from Redwood to preserve the evaluation state while your PO routes.

What Redwood will preserve during the extension (no additional charges during this period):
- Full sandbox environment with current tokens and workspace state
- Model endpoints and saved prompts / test datasets
- Logs and basic observability for debugging (retention unchanged)

We will not enable production-only features (dedicated capacity or account-level metering) under this extension. If the PO completes, billing will transition per the agreed terms in your PO.

I have approved a 72-hour sandbox voucher which is attached as 72hr_sandbox_voucher.pdf — this will be applied immediately to your account and preserve the environment. If you send the one-line procurement confirmation that the PO is actively routing, we will extend up to 10 business days under the same terms and log an internal case note linking to your PO draft.

Attachments: 72hr_sandbox_voucher.pdf (PDF, 6 KB), extension_terms.txt (TXT, 1 KB)

If 10 business days is required now, I can escalate to Grace for manager sign-off; Grace, can you confirm if we can pre-authorize the full 10-business-day safety net for StarkMed if procurement sends the routing confirmation?

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Lydia Torres <lydia.torres@starkmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@starkmed.com>
Date: 2027-03-26T10:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement routing causing access gap

Marissa — this works, thank you.

Procurement confirms the PO is active and routed; expected completion is 8 business days from today. Please apply the 72-hour voucher now and mark the case note that StarkMed PO-DRAFT-4598 is in routing. Billing contact will be: Claire Nguyen (claire.nguyen@starkmed.com).

We appreciate the quick accommodation — Evan and I will follow up if the routing timeline changes.
